body:
Implemented and verified locally in commit `46a29bd72` on `codex/v3-diataxis-navigation`, based on local `releases/v3.0.0` at `18a9809b3`. No push or deployment has been performed; leaving this issue open pending landing.

The English sidebar now distinguishes learning (ordered Tutorials), task work (combined How-to Guides), explanation (Core Concepts), and lookup (API Reference). Next Steps and tutorial/reference entry pages explain those paths. The CLI pages have distinct overview/detail titles and cross-links, the Go-call guide has a searchable task title, FAQ is reachable, and Contribute docs remains directly visible. Single-page desktop topics open directly. Existing slugs and heading IDs are preserved; no pages were added/deleted and no API examples were rewritten.

Validation with the published M-Press v1.0.20 executable:
- Strict build passed: 2,031 pages and 2,192 files.
- M-Press link/asset check passed; 19 documentation helper tests passed.
- Rendered comparison retained all 153 previously navigated URLs (155 now), and all previous heading anchors on the seven edited pages.
- Actual browser checks verified ordered tutorials, Go-call discovery (first search result), separate CLI overview/detail search results, desktop/mobile menus, direct Clipboard access, and contribution/help/migration routes. Screenshots inspected at 1440×1000 and 390×844.
- Responsive TOC browser regression passed phone, short-phone, tablet and desktop sizes in light/dark themes, keyboard/focus, swipe, resize and no-JavaScript cases.
- CodeRabbit review completed; its one finding was the existing examples URL pointing to an unpublished release ref. GitHub API checks confirmed it, and the link now points to the available `releases/v3-beta` examples directory.
- Translation coverage and generated-site gates retain exactly the same nine missing `contributing/release-policy` translations as the release checkout. The translation audit also reports stale/structure warnings; translations are intentionally outside this English pass and were not fabricated.

This is an incremental navigation/onboarding improvement, not a complete rewrite or a first-time-user study. API accuracy work remains tracked in #6337; wider reader-experience work remains in #6338.
